open.steps: 1. Review the current bug report form fields and identify which are truly essential. 2. Make only the title and description fields required. 3. Convert severity, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior to optional fields. 4. Add helpful placeholder text to guide users filling out optional fields. 5. Test the simplified form to ensure it works correctly.
open.expected: Users should be able to submit a bug report with minimal required fields (e.g., just a title and description), with optional fields for severity, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
